Thanks for taking the time. Please read this before you go further.

This repository is a copy of `@beerwright/core`, the engine inside Beerwright. It's synced from
Beerwright's own repository every time a new version of the app goes live, so
a change merged here would be overwritten on the next sync. That's why I'm not
taking pull requests here. Please open an issue instead and we can talk it
through.

If I accept a fix, I'll make it in Beerwright's repository with you as
co-author on the commit, and it will show up here on the next sync. I'll
close this pull request with a link to it when that happens.
